name: MM-MT-Bench
description: A multi-turn LLM-as-a-judge evaluation benchmark for testing multimodal instruction-tuned models' ability to follow user instructions in multi-turn dialogues and answer open-ended questions in a zero-shot manner.
reputation: Extension of MT-Bench to multimodal settings; uses LLM-as-judge scoring; less widely cited than its text-only counterpart MT-Bench
notes: Adapts the MT-Bench methodology (Zheng et al., 2023) to multimodal inputs. Uses GPT-4 as judge. Small set of 40 multi-turn questions covering image understanding, reasoning, and instruction following. Subject to position bias inherent in LLM-judge setups.
